question: Which continuous causal OHLC conditions mark the onset of a clean upward or downward price path from the next-bar open?

interpretation.operational_time_language: first barrier confirmation time, not the unknowable true start of a move
interpretation.universe_selection: previously assembled twenty-two-stock 2024 convenience cohort; the target and algorithms are entry-sign research, but the universe is inherited

periods.prediction_schedule: generate monthly expanding OOF probabilities for June through December; June calibrates July alert thresholds and each later score month uses only the immediately preceding OOF month
periods.train_rule: an anchor may train a monthly model only when its entire future path ends strictly before that month begins

fold_chronology.interpretation: causal monthly expanding OOF development, not a globally sealed July-December holdout

sources.provider_price_basis: provider OHLC exactly as stored; no independent corporate-action adjustment

universe.training_weighting: raw weight 1 divided by the number of represented sessions for that symbol and the eligible row count for that symbol/session; normalize all weights to mean one
universe.metric_aggregation: within symbol/session first, then equal-symbol aggregation

bar_validation.ohlc_order_required: low <= min(open, close) <= max(open, close) <= high
bar_validation.gap_handling: start a new causal segment whenever adjacent timestamps within a symbol/session differ from exactly five minutes

decision_and_path.reference_price: open of exact next five-minute bar t+1
decision_and_path.future_path: all highs and lows from t+1 through t+h inclusive in the same exact segment
decision_and_path.segment_first_bar_true_range: use 10000 * log(high/low) because no exact prior close exists
decision_and_path.causal_scale: median true_range_bps over the last min(12, available) exact bars ending at t-1
decision_and_path.open_gap_ordering: on each future bar, an open at or beyond exactly one barrier establishes that barrier first
decision_and_path.dual_touch_inside_open: if the open is inside both barriers and that bar high and low touch both, classify intrabar_ambiguous and never infer ordering
decision_and_path.conservative_precision: wrong-first, no-hit, and ambiguous alerts all count as failures
decision_and_path.pre_confirmation_adverse_endpoint: include the first-confirmation bar conservatively because within-bar ordering beyond the frozen first-touch rule is unknowable

features.source: the exact frozen forty-feature continuous causal OHLC surface from clean_slate_causal_ohlc_entries_v1
features.rolling_scope: current exact symbol/session segment ending at t

algorithms.name: clock_logit
algorithms.scaler: StandardScaler fitted on training rows only

algorithms.name: full_logit
algorithms.scaler: StandardScaler fitted on training rows only

thresholds_and_onsets.threshold_source: immediately preceding month's OOF probabilities for the same algorithm and horizon
thresholds_and_onsets.weighted_quantile_weights: equal symbol and equal symbol/session using the frozen metric-weight formula
thresholds_and_onsets.weighted_quantile_method: left-continuous inverse weighted empirical CDF: the smallest stably sorted value whose cumulative weight is at least q times total weight
thresholds_and_onsets.long_fire: P(long_first) >= prior-month long fire threshold and P(long_first) > P(short_first)
thresholds_and_onsets.short_fire: P(short_first) >= prior-month short fire threshold and P(short_first) > P(long_first)
thresholds_and_onsets.conflict: if both sides meet fire conditions, record conflict and emit no onset
thresholds_and_onsets.state_reset: reset both side arms at each symbol/session/exact-segment boundary
thresholds_and_onsets.hysteresis: after a side fires it cannot fire again until its probability drops below that side's prior-month 75th-percentile rearm threshold
thresholds_and_onsets.primary_event: first causal fire after an armed state; persistent high scores are one entry-sign episode

matched_clock_controls.coverage: one outcome-blind clock control for each candidate onset
matched_clock_controls.side: the candidate onset side is imposed on its control
matched_clock_controls.selection_score: clock_logit probability for the imposed side, descending
matched_clock_controls.history_availability_bucket: 0 when availability_12 < 0.5; 1 when 0.5 <= availability_12 < 1.0; 2 when availability_12 == 1.0
relaxation_tiers: same symbol/month/horizon/side and 30-minute clock bin/availability bucket
matched_clock_controls.candidate_processing_order: onset_id ascending within candidate algorithm, horizon, and side
matched_clock_controls.same_session_policy: tier 0 requires a different session; relaxation tiers 1 through 3 may use the same session when necessary

hypotheses.question: Do continuous OHLC features improve every-anchor three-class probability quality over clock alone?
hypotheses.stop_condition: proper-score advantage is not positive at every horizon or lacks temporal/stock stability

hypotheses.question: Does shallow nonlinear structure improve every-anchor three-class probability quality over clock alone?
hypotheses.stop_condition: proper-score advantage is not positive at every horizon or lacks temporal/stock stability

hypotheses.question: Do interpretable score onsets identify cleaner and earlier direction confirmations than equal-coverage clock controls, long and short separately?
hypotheses.stop_condition: support, conservative precision, quality, speed, bootstrap, month, or stock stability fails

hypotheses.question: Do nonlinear score onsets identify cleaner and earlier direction confirmations than equal-coverage clock controls, long and short separately?
hypotheses.stop_condition: support, conservative precision, quality, speed, bootstrap, month, or stock stability fails

hypotheses.question: Which pre-evaluation-join feature groups repeatedly cause the causal monthly fitted algorithms to fire across months and stocks?
hypotheses.stop_condition: contribution direction appears in fewer than five months or fewer than fifteen stocks

entry_onset: rapid correct confirmation within three bars

inference.unit: session date with within-symbol/session aggregation first
inference.bootstrap: paired non-circular overlapping five-session moving-block bootstrap

retention_gate_per_candidate_side.pass_interpretation: retain only as a recurring 2024 internal entry-sign hypothesis for genuinely new shadow sessions
retention_gate_per_candidate_side.failure_interpretation: reject or leave descriptive; do not alter barriers, thresholds, sides, features, or reason groups after outcomes are opened

reason_extraction.full_logit: exact chosen-direction versus opposite-direction standardized logit contributions, aggregated into frozen feature groups; contributions plus intercept must reconstruct the directional logit margin
reason_extraction.full_hgb: chosen-direction probability-margin change when one frozen feature group is replaced by fold-training medians; label as local sensitivity, not additive or causal explanation
reason_extraction.post_outcome_correct_vs_failed_enrichmen: exploratory only and cannot rescue any hypothesis

integrity.pre_outcome_artifact_filename_semantics: legacy shorthand meaning before the final all-fold evaluation join; it does not mean that prior completed validation-month training labels were globally unread
